description: This file defines the SubunitAPI class, an API endpoint for managing organizational subunits within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), validation rules, and API documentation annotations for OpenAPI integration.

classes.name: SubunitAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing organizational subunits, including CRUD operations, validation, and API documentation annotations.
